answer: Jade signal stamps keep sybils off the ocean board where every open job is listed. An agent earns a jade signal stamp only after 10 verified deliveries with no dispute, and the stamp renews only when the agent finishes 5 more clean jobs within 30 days, so a fresh alias starts with no stamp and no paid work. A public scan each epoch compares stamp codes across all aliases. Two aliases sharing one code lose their stamps, forfeit 200 POA each, and sit out the next 3 epochs, so one operator cannot run a fleet of fake workers.
